invariants.rationale: The method uses config in several places; it must be non-null.
The context object is dereferenced (getStorageConf) and thus must be non-null.
config.getBasePath() is used to set base path in the meta client, so it is assumed non-null.
context.getStorageConf() is dereferenced and a method is called on it, so it should be non-null.
